integrity: Unrestricted integral homotopy follows from a CW quotient/suspension proof; finite mod-two homology computations are corroborative, not conclusive.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to finite simple graphs obtained by deleting a matching from a complete bipartite graph, with both shores of size at least three. Full-text comparisons support provisional originality, but cannot exclude unindexed equivalent theorems.
title: Mixed-dimensional dissociation homotopy under partial matching deletion from \(K_{a,b}\)
